meta.title: Formalized Proof Blueprint: Riemann Hypothesis & Generalized Riemann Hypothesis

stages.label: Final Theorems
stages.description: Standalone target statements and top-level proved theorems for the Riemann Hypothesis, Dirichlet L-function half-plane nonvanishing, and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.

stages.label: Functional-Equation & Character Reductions
stages.description: Analytic bridges reducing critical-line zero localization for zeta(s) and arbitrary/primitive Dirichlet L-functions to half-plane nonvanishing Re(s) > 1/2 via Euler factors, Gamma factors, and functional equations.

stages.label: Main Bridge Theorems & Dominators
stages.description: High-impact assembly bottlenecks merging local-global Galois representations, modularity/Selmer windows, theta-correspondence lifts, and Arakelov covolume bounds.

stages.label: Major Theory Pillars
stages.description: Core mathematical engines: windowed Chebyshev/Landau zero-free regions, weight-one geometric realization and Lefschetz traces, theta-kernel Parseval lifts, Local Langlands with tame types, U(3) Selmer growth, Kato's Euler system, Moriwaki bigness, and Harish-Chandra/Flath representation theory.

stages.label: Foundational Machinery
stages.description: Underlying arithmetic-geometric, cohomological, and analytic infrastructure: PEL Shimura toroidal compactification and Mumford semiabelian uniformisation, resolution of singularities, twisted etale cohomology finiteness, Poitou-Tate duality, Whittaker multiplicity one, Arakelov slope bounds, and Formalism specification contracts.

theory_groups.label: Modularity, Selmer Bounds & Kato Euler Systems

nodes.title: Main Exported Theorems (RH, Half-Plane Nonvanishing, GRH)
nodes.plain_english: Exports the five headline unconditional theorems of the entire formalization: the classical Riemann Hypothesis (both in Mathlib's canonical formulation and as an explicit critical-line statement), nonvanishing of all Dirichlet L-functions in the half-plane Re(s) > 1/2 away from the trivial pole at s = 1, and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis placing all critical-strip zeros of arbitrary and primitive Dirichlet L-functions on Re(s) = 1/2.
nodes.math_statement: RiemannHypothesis ∧ (∀ N ≥ 1, ∀ χ mod N, ∀ s ∈ ℂ, Re(s) > 1/2 ∧ (χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) ⇒ L(χ, s) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ N ≥ 1, ∀ χ mod N, ∀ s ∈ ℂ, 0 < Re(s) < 1 ∧ L(χ, s) = 0 ⇒ Re(s) = 1/2)
nodes.notes: Root module (dist=0, height=202). Exports riemannHypothesis (L4), riemannZeta_eq_zero_re (L6), LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re (L8), LFunction_eq_zero_re (L10), and LFunction_eq_zero_re_of_isPrimitive (L12).

nodes.title: Standalone Target Specifications
nodes.plain_english: Defines the four standalone target mathematical propositions using only standard Mathlib primitives so auditors can verify exact theorem statements without traversing the full proof graph.
nodes.math_statement: RiemannZetaZerosOnLine, DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf, DirichletLZerosOnLine, PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine
nodes.notes: pure specification leaf depending only on Mathlib (dist=1, height=0).

nodes.title: Critical-Line & Small-Class-Number Packaging
nodes.plain_english: Pairs the top-level RH/GRH theorem exports with specialized small-class-number arithmetic modules (proving class number 1 for Q(sqrt(-3)) and characterizing vanishing of Selmer modules).
nodes.math_statement: MainTheorems ∧ (h(Q(√-3)) = 1) ∧ (len = 0 ⇔ Vanish) ∧ OnePoint

nodes.title: Top-Level Analytic Reductions (allChi, rhOfAll, critAll, claimAll)
nodes.plain_english: Receives the unconditional proof that every Dirichlet L-function is nonvanishing for Re(s) > 1/2 and immediately deduces Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis, GRH for primitive characters, and GRH for all characters.
nodes.math_statement: allChi : EveryCharacter ⇒ rhOfAll : RiemannHypothesis ∧ critAll : PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine ∧ claimAll : (HalfPlane ∧ Strip ∧ Zeta)
nodes.notes: Top bottleneck in Supplements/Kernels (dist=3, height=199).

nodes.title: Functional-Equation Reflection for Primitive L-Functions
nodes.plain_english: Proves that archimedean Gamma factors of Dirichlet characters never vanish for Re(s) > 0, and reflects any putative critical-strip zero with Re(s) < 1/2 across s ↦ 1 - s via the completed functional equation to contradict half-plane nonvanishing.
nodes.math_statement: (∀ χ, Re(s) > 0 ⇒ γ(χ, s) ≠ 0) ∧ (EveryCharacter ⇒ ∀ χ primitive, 0 < Re(s) < 1, L(χ, s) = 0 ⇒ Re(s) = 1/2)
nodes.notes: Also proves Formalism.VW.rh_of_every (L29) by specializing EveryCharacter to the trivial character mod 1.

nodes.title: Riemann Zeta Functional-Equation Reflection
nodes.plain_english: Elementary complex-analytic proof that nonvanishing of zeta(s) on Re(s) > 1/2 (s ≠ 1) implies the Riemann Hypothesis, handling the trivial zeros at negative even integers explicitly via cos(π(1-s)/2) and Gamma(1-s).
nodes.math_statement: (∀ s ∈ ℂ, Re(s) > 1/2 ∧ s ≠ 1 ⇒ ζ(s) ≠ 0) ⇒ RiemannHypothesis
nodes.notes: leaf theorem proved directly from Mathlib's riemannZeta_one_sub.

nodes.title: Imprimitive-to-Primitive Reduction & Strip Localization
nodes.plain_english: Eliminates zeros of imprimitive Dirichlet L-functions in the critical strip by showing each prime Euler factor (1 - ψ(p)p⁻ˢ) is nonzero for Re(s) > 0, passing to the primitive conductor and reflecting across s ↦ 1 - s.
nodes.math_statement: Claim.HalfPlane ⇒ Claim.Strip ∧ Claim.Zeta (using |ψ(p)p⁻ˢ| < 1 for Re(s) > 0)
nodes.notes: Also proves Claim.zeta (L75) and Claim.zeta_iff (L102).

nodes.title: Analytic Claim Definitions (HalfPlane, Strip, Zeta)
nodes.plain_english: Defines the three core analytic predicates linking right-half-plane nonvanishing of all Dirichlet L-functions to critical-line localization for Dirichlet L-functions and the Riemann zeta function.
nodes.math_statement: Claim.HalfPlane : ∀ N χ s, Re(s) > 1/2 ∧ (χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) ⇒ L(χ, s) ≠ 0
nodes.notes: Mathlib leaf file defining Claim.HalfPlane, Claim.Strip, and Claim.Zeta.

nodes.title: Master Proof Synthesis (UpperTheory.FinalTheorems.everyCharacter)

nodes.math_statement: UpperTheory.FinalTheorems.everyCharacter : ∀ N ≥ 1, ∀ χ mod N, ∀ s ∈ ℂ, Re(s) > 1/2 ∧ (χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) ⇒ L(χ, s) ≠ 0
nodes.notes: apex inside Development (dist=4, height=198). Discharges OpenLiteratureStatements via ⟨row_src, rec_t_exists, row_src⟩ and OpenImageCondition via ⟨row_src⟩.

nodes.title: Arakelov Self-Intersection & Covolume Bridge (CovolX)
nodes.plain_english: Synthesizes resolution of singularities, Moriwaki bigness, Fargues' exact sequence, Zarhin's trick, Nef Riemann-Roch, Scholze-Weinstein, and Fubini-Study Chow heights to establish the global Arakelov covolume bound CovolX.

nodes.title: Covolume Lower Bound from Slimness & Height Theorems

nodes.title: Small-Class-Number Selmer Length Growth Bound over Q(sqrt(-3))
nodes.plain_english: Instantiates LiteratureRankNHypothesis unconditionally and applies the unitary U(3) Selmer patching theorem to Q(sqrt(-3)) (class number 1), yielding an explicit polynomial bound C*(e+1)^A on weighted sums of Shafarevich-Tate lengths.
nodes.math_statement: ∃ C A ∈ ℕ, ∀ e ≥ 1 even, ∑_{l ∈ Ls} log(l) · length(Sha_U(χ_cyc^{-e})) / e_O ≤ C · (e + 1)^A
nodes.notes: Top-level Selmer realization (dist=2, height=198) proved alongside bound (L27).

nodes.title: Windowed Chebyshev Inequality from Design Choices (topDesWin)
nodes.plain_english: Transforms admissible finite-family designs (DesignExists) and closed parameter bounds (LinkN, LinkDIVt, LinkG, LinkS, LinkIRR, LinkGLOBAL) into a connected family satisfying the tied Chebyshev inequality on scale windows.
nodes.math_statement: DesignExists(WithTw(WithSm 𝒞')) ∧ LinkN ∧ LinkDIVt ∧ LinkG ∧ LinkS ∧ LinkIRR ∧ LinkGLOBAL ⇒ FamilyClassConnected ℰ

nodes.title: Windowed Landau Nonvanishing Criterion (zeroFreeOn_of_tiedWin_cyc)
nodes.plain_english: Proves that if for every primitive character ψ the smoothed prime-power sum Gm(x) on its cyclic subgroup level satisfies Gm(x) <= x^{1/2 + O(eps)} along unbounded windows [Y, Y^λ] (λ > 1), then L(ψ, s) ≠ 0 for all Re(s) > 1/2.
nodes.math_statement: (∀ ψ, ChebyshevInequalityAtWindowScale λ (Level.cyc ψ)) ∧ (∀ ψ, Λ_ψ.Gm(x) ≤ x^{1/2 + C·ε}) ⇒ ∀ ψ, Re(s) > 1/2 ⇒ L(ψ, s) ≠ 0
nodes.notes: Wraps Landau.zero_free_of_Chebyshev_growth (Landau.lean L538) and ExplicitFormulaErrorOfHostConditions; coupled with CoreGm (CoreGm.lean L12).

nodes.title: Weight-One Geometric Realization (Crystalline Towers & Kodaira-Spencer)
nodes.plain_english: Synthesizes crystalline comparison towers, p-adic Witt lattices, finite-etale Kodaira-Spencer models (ksGood_holds), and Hodge-Tate jumps from the holomorphic Lefschetz trace formula to construct the weight-one geometric realization GeoOne.
nodes.math_statement: HolomorphicLefschetzFormula ∧ CrysStep ∧ JumpStep ∧ KSGood ⇒ GeoOne
nodes.notes: Rank 6 dominator (dist=6, height=194), immediate child of WeightOneGeometricRealization .

nodes.title: Holomorphic Lefschetz Fixed-Point Formula for Finite Etale Correspondences
nodes.plain_english: Proves the holomorphic Lefschetz fixed-point formula for finite etale correspondences (c1, c2 : Y → Z) on smooth projective schemes over C, equating the alternating trace on Hodge cohomology H^b(Z, Ω^a) to fixed-point tangent-matrix residues.
nodes.math_statement: ∑_{b=0}^d (-1)^b Tr(Tr_{c₁} ∘ c₂^* | H^b(Z, Ω^a)) = ∑_{y ∈ Fix(c₁, c₂)} [X^a] det(I + X·A_y) / det(I - A_y)
nodes.notes: complete proof decomposing Z into integral clopen components and reducing via Hodge restriction isomorphisms.

nodes.title: Theta-Kernel Parseval Lift & Nonvanishing (tLift_holds_k)
nodes.plain_english: Constructs nonvanishing global unitary theta lifts U → U' from U(n) to large definite/skew unitary spaces U(d) using the regularized Siegel-Weil formula, doubling method, Rallis inner product, and Schwartz-Bruhat test vectors.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ U ⊂ 𝒜_cusp(U(n)) of regular weight λ, ∀ d ≥ d₀, ∃ U' ⊂ 𝒜(U(d)), IsLift(χ_X, χ_W, U, U')
nodes.notes: Assembles tools_holds_k (Siegel-Weil standard, Eisenstein continuation, doubling, unimodularity) to discharge UpperTheory.TP.TLiftK in TLiftK.lean.

nodes.title: Local Langlands Correspondence for GL_n with Tame Inertia Types
nodes.plain_english: Constructs a local reciprocity correspondence rc mapping irreducible smooth representations of GL_n(E_w) to Weil-Deligne representations, extending the supercuspidal correspondence via Bernstein-Zelevinsky segments and verifying dimension, character twists, central characters, duals, injectivity, and depth-zero tame type laws.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ E_w non-archimedean, ∃ rc : Irr(GL_n(E_w)) → WD(W_{E_w}), LawsT(rc) (bijection, segments, twists, central chars, depth-0 types)
nodes.notes: Combines local Artin map (artEx), supercuspidal correspondence (cuspEx), Zelevinsky extension (exists_isLExt), and depth-zero cuspidality (DzLCusp).

nodes.title: Unitary U(3) Selmer Growth Bound (CorGK → CountI)
nodes.plain_english: Converts the global U(3) Selmer growth inequality CorGK over auxiliary imaginary quadratic fields K*(p) into the prime-averaged Selmer length bound CountI across cyclic character orbits.
nodes.math_statement: U3.CorGK ⇒ ∀ χ, ∃ A r₁ r₂, ∑_{l ∈ Ls} log(l) · ∑_{ψ ∈ X(c_l, e)} V_n(ψ) ≤ (N·t)^A
nodes.notes: Key Selmer counting step using subgroup orbit decomposition (orbSum) and cyclicity of (Z/NZ)^× / K' inside UnitaryThreeGroups.

nodes.title: Kato Euler System & Smoothed Zeta-Class Hodge-Tate Law
nodes.plain_english: Establishes the unramified zeta-element divisibility criterion ZetaUr by combining Kato's Euler-system integrality with the smoothed zeta-class Hodge-Tate law and admissible Hecke projection nonvanishing.
nodes.math_statement: KatoEulerSystemIntegrality ∧ SmoothedZetaClassHodgeTateLaw ⇒ GlobalTheory.Ord2.ZetaUr
nodes.notes: Rank 24 dominator (dist=6, height=121) feeding KatoTwo in WindowBoundOfLiteratureLevel.

nodes.title: Good Root-Tower Existence & Arakelov Volume Theorem
nodes.plain_english: Proves both the existence of good root towers of Shimura models and the Arakelov volume lower bound VolumeTheoremX by combining Arakelov intersection systems, Moriwaki Hilbert-Samuel/bigness, Fargues Hodge-Tate, Zarhin, Bost-Zhang slope vectors, and complex theta uniformisation.
nodes.math_statement: ArithIntersectionSystem ∧ MoriwakiHS ∧ MoriwakiBig ∧ FarguesHodgeTate ∧ Zarhin ⇒ GoodTowerExistsX ∧ VolumeTheoremX
nodes.notes: Rank 19 dominator (dist=11, height=129) wrapping FinalTheoremOfInputsRight and GoodTowerVolumeTheorem .

nodes.title: Moriwaki Arithmetic Bigness & Hilbert-Samuel Volume Chain
nodes.plain_english: Proves Moriwaki's arithmetic bigness criterion unconditionally from resolution of singularities, the Poincare-Lelong formula for Arakelov intersection systems, and dense bounded-height curves via an arithmetic Hilbert-Samuel devissage chain.
nodes.math_statement: MoriwakiBigStatement ∧ HSUse (arithmetic volume bigness for nef/semipositive adelic line bundles)
nodes.notes: Instantiates MoriwakiBigStatement and HSUse outright (dist=7, height=100) via HSChain.lean.

nodes.title: Weight-One Hilbert Eisenstein Series Construction
nodes.plain_english: Constructs holomorphic Hilbert modular Eisenstein series of parallel weight one over totally real fields, proving Poisson summation, moderate growth, smoothness, K-finiteness, level conditions, and explicit Fourier expansions.
nodes.math_statement: UpperTheory.V.Published.HilbertEisOne (existence & Fourier expansions of weight-1 Hilbert Eisenstein series)
nodes.notes: Key PositivityTheory realization (dist=7, height=110) used in automorphy-lifting/congruence arguments.

nodes.title: Capelli Infinitesimal Character of U(p, q) Discrete Series
nodes.plain_english: Proves via Casselman-Osborne Lie algebra cohomology, Koszul resolutions, and Verma covers that the quantum determinant in U(gl_n) acts on smooth vectors of any discrete series representation of U(p, q) as the scalar Harish-Chandra polynomial.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ π ∈ DiscreteSeries(U(p, q)) of parameter λ, ∀ v ∈ π^∞, qdet(E + (n-1)/2 + Y) · v = capP(λ, Y) · v
nodes.notes: CompanionTheory assembly proving PI.DSInfCharCap.DSInfCharCap .

nodes.title: Unitary Admissibility & Flath Tensor Product Factorization
nodes.plain_english: Proves that every irreducible smooth/unitary representation of an adelic unitary group U(J)(A_F) is admissible and decomposes as a restricted tensor product over all archimedean and non-archimedean places.
nodes.math_statement: UnitaryIrreducibleAdmissible ∧ FlathTensorProduct (π ≅ ⊗'_v π_v over all places v)
nodes.notes: Proved in CompanionTheory/RealGroups from Hecke algebra commutativity, Witt/Cartan decompositions, and archimedean principal series.

nodes.title: PEL Shimura Toroidal Compactification & Boundary Uniformisation
nodes.plain_english: Defines the global PEL-type unitary Shimura toroidal compactification specification PartI: existence of integral toroidal models with split boundary fibers, Mumford semiabelian uniformisation N3, torsion/Weil-pairing isomorphisms, and formal power-series arc lifts N4.
nodes.math_statement: PartI : ∀ (E CM) (H) (D), ∃ integral toroidal models Y with SplitFibres, Model.N2, Model.N3 (PELUnif), Model.N4 (formal arcs Spec O'[[X]] → Y)
nodes.notes: #1 most-imported interface file in the entire repository .

nodes.title: Uniqueness of Mumford Semiabelian Uniformisation
nodes.plain_english: Formulates UnifUniqSt (wrapped in Laws6): any two Mumford degeneration uniformisations of the same polarized semiabelian scheme compatible with rigidified line bundles are canonically isomorphic, preserving O_E-actions, theta sections, and thick-level coordinates.
nodes.math_statement: UnifUniqSt : (U, U' uniformisations of G over (R, I) with w_L) ⇒ ∃! isomorphism D ≅ D' compatible with O_E and theta frames
nodes.notes: #2 most-imported external interface file .

nodes.title: 24-Law Contract for Polarized Abelian Schemes
nodes.plain_english: Packages 24 foundational theorems for polarized abelian schemes over arbitrary Noetherian bases: Riemann-Roch section rank n^g, base change, ampleness (n >= 4), Theorem of the Cube and Square, rigidity, Weil pairing nondegeneracy, Mumford theta-group irreducibility, Serre's M-torsion rigidity (M >= 3), and finite-flat quotients.
nodes.math_statement: Laws : dim H⁰(A, L^n) = n^g ∧ Ample(n≥4) ∧ Cube ∧ Square ∧ Rigidity ∧ WeilNondeg ∧ ThetaIrred ∧ Serre(M≥3) ∧ Quotient
nodes.notes: contract . Its realization connects to TheoremOfCubeAbelianSchemeOverArbitraryBase (h=97 on the 202-edge critical spine).

nodes.title: Split Tori & Semiabelian Torsion Primitives (Critical Spine Base)
nodes.plain_english: Constructs split algebraic tori Spec(R[X]) as Hopf-algebra group schemes over arbitrary base schemes S, together with character groups, multiplication-by-N maps, and N-torsion subgroup schemes.
nodes.math_statement: splitTorus(S, X) = Spec(O_S[X]), G_m(S), mulN : G → G, torsion(G, N) = ker([N] : G → G)
nodes.notes: Terminal height-0 leaf of the longest 202-edge (203-module) critical spine in the entire DAG.

nodes.title: Finiteness of Twisted Etale Cohomology Over Fields
nodes.plain_english: Proves finiteness of twisted etale cohomology H^n(X, Z/qZ(i)) for proper schemes X over arbitrary fields k (with q invertible in k) by double induction on cohomological degree n and Krull dimension, slicing into families of smooth curves via alterations, Kummer theory, and ghost-killing.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ k field, q ∈ k^×, X/k proper, ∀ n i ∈ ℤ, Finite(H^n_et(X, Z/qZ(i)))
nodes.notes: Core inductive engine (goal_of) for Development/EtaleCohomology .

nodes.title: Functorial Resolution of Singularities in Characteristic Zero
nodes.plain_english: Establishes functorial embedded resolution of singularities and ideal principalization over characteristic-zero schemes via iterated blowups along smooth centers, producing strict normal crossings exceptional divisors compatible with smooth morphisms and field extensions.
nodes.math_statement: FunctorialResolutionCharZero ⇒ ResolutionCharZero (smooth blowup resolution with SNC exceptional divisor)
nodes.notes: Bridges Development/ResolutionOfSingularities into Arakelov height and Moriwaki bigness pipelines.

nodes.title: Poitou-Tate Nine-Term Exact Sequence & Sha Duality
nodes.plain_english: Proves Poitou-Tate global-local duality for finite Z/NZ Galois modules over G_{K,S} (for N odd or K totally complex): finiteness and perfect pairing of Tate-Shafarevich groups Sha^1 and Sha^2, compact-support duality, and exactness of the full nine-term Poitou-Tate sequence.
nodes.math_statement: Finite(Sha¹(G_{K,S}, M)) ∧ Finite(Sha²(G_{K,S}, M*(1))) ∧ Exact(0 → H⁰ → ∏' H⁰ → H²* → ... → ∏' H² → 0)
nodes.notes: Complete proof in GroundTheory/ProfiniteCohomology of poitouTate_duality_gs, poitouTate_sha_gs, and poitouTate_nineTerm_gs.

nodes.title: Whittaker Multiplicity One on GL_n(A_K)
nodes.plain_english: Proves the Piatetski-Shapiro / Shalika Fourier-Whittaker theorem for smooth cuspidal automorphic forms on GL_n(A_K): by upward induction on unipotent row expansions, if all Whittaker coefficients of a cusp form vanish, then the form itself is identically zero.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ ϕ ∈ 𝒜_cusp(GL_n(K)\GL_n(A_K)), (∀ g, W_ϕ(g) = 0) ⇒ ϕ = 0
nodes.notes: proof in GroundTheory/AutomorphicForms .

nodes.title: Arakelov Hermitian Vector Bundles & Bost-Zhang Slope Inequalities
nodes.plain_english: Defines Hermitian lattices (metrized projective O_K-modules with conjugate-compatible positive-definite inner products at infinite places), Arakelov sub/quotient degrees and slopes, and formalizes the Bost-Zhang small-height vector existence bound.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ (F : HermLattice K i), ∀ ε > 0, ∃ K'/K finite, ∃ v ∈ F ⊗ K' \ {0}, lineDegree(v) ≥ μ(F) - (1/2)log(i) - ε
nodes.notes: core interface in GroundTheory/HeightsAndTheta .

nodes.title: Rapid Decay & L² Moments of Compactly Supported Cusp-Form Twists
nodes.plain_english: Proves that multiplying a smooth cusp form invariant under the split center by any compactly supported continuous cutoff of log|det| yields an L² function on H_n with finite moments against all powers of the Siegel height weight.
nodes.math_statement: ∀ ψ cusp form, ∀ u ∈ C_c(ℝ), ψ(x) · u(ldet x) ∈ L²(H_n, ν) ∧ ∫ wt(x)^{2M} |ψ(x)u(ldet x)|² dν < ∞
nodes.notes: proof in Development/DiscreteGroups , top interface file of DiscreteGroups.

nodes.title: Local Bloch-Kato Orthogonality & Tate Duality Core
nodes.plain_english: Specifies continuous p-adic Galois representations GRep, de Rham criteria (dim D_dR = [K:Q_p] dim V), and rational/integral Bloch-Kato exact orthogonality of finite-part cocycles H¹_f under the local Tate cup-product pairing.
nodes.math_statement: IsDR(ρ) ⇒ (H¹_f(G_K, V) ⊥ H¹_f(G_K, V*(1))) ∧ (H¹_f(T_A) ⊥ H¹_f(T_{A'})) under local cup product
